{{Top|fa}} {{Character |type=Resistance |image=[[File:Dreanna_Conunda_TROSVD.png]] |name=Dreanna Conunda |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]]''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' |gender= |pronouns=She/her |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes= |skin=Light |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[New Republic]] **[[New Academy]] *[[Corellian Engineering Corporation]] *[[Resistance]] **[[Exegol landing team]]{{Film|IX}} |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|This'll be rough!|Dreanna Conunda warns those on board the ''Fortitude'' before landing on the ''Steadfast''|audio=Conunda-Rough-TROSJr.flac|''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel]]''}} '''Dreanna Conunda''' was a [[human]] [[pilot]] who worked as a [[flight instructor]] at the [[New Republic]] [[New Academy|academy]] on the [[planet]] [[Chandrila]], also acting as a test pilot for the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. By [[35 ABY]], she had joined the [[Resistance]] in its [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[First Order]], serving as a [[Resistance pilot|pilot]] at the [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|Resistance base]] on the [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]]. Conunda flew as [[captain]] of the [[YC-123B transport hauler]] [[Fortitude (transport)|''Fortitude'']], with [[Lieutenant]] [[Gandris Dyun]] as her co-pilot. The pair shared compatibility and chemistry, and there were rumors that their relationship went beyond professional. When the Resistance mounted its [[Battle of Exegol|attack]] on the [[Sith Eternal]]'s [[Sith Eternal military|forces]] on the planet [[Exegol]], Conunda transported the Resistance's [[Exegol landing team]] on board the ''Fortitude'' through the [[Galactic Barrier]] that separated Exegol from the rest of [[the galaxy]]. After reaching Exegol, she spotted the [[navigation tower]] that the landing team were tasked with destroying, but it was deactivated before the [[transport]] could reach it. [[General]] [[Finn]] then had Conunda land the ''Fortitude'' on the surface of the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Steadfast (Resurgent-class)|''Steadfast'']], the new source of the signal that had been transmitted from the tower. The landing team charged from the transport and successfully stopped the signal, after which Conunda evacuated the survivors from the [[Star Destroyer]]'s surface and eventually returned them to Ajan Kloss after the Resistance claimed victory. ==Biorgaphy== ===''Fortitude'' flyer=== {{Quote|I know it's a rough ride… but stay locked on Rey's course.|Poe Dameron directs Dreanna Conunda and the other pilots as they fly through the Galactic Barrier|audio=Dameron-GalacticBarrier-TROS.flac|}} [[Captain]] Dreanna Conunda was a [[human]] who, during the [[New Republic Era|reign]] of the [[New Republic]], served as one of the youngest [[flight instructor]]s at the Republic's [[New Academy|training academy]] on the [[planet]] [[Chandrila]]. As well as [[Teacher|teaching]], Conunda flew as a test [[pilot]] for the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation]], splitting her [[time]] between the roles as the school [[Standard year|year]] permitted. However, during the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]], she worked instead as the [[Resistance pilot]] of the [[YC-123B transport hauler]] [[Fortitude (transport)|''Fortitude'']], which earned the nickname of "lucky lander" among the [[Trooper|troops]] for its successful track record of dropping off or picking up [[soldier]]s from combat zones. Based at the [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|Resistance base]] on the [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]], Conunda flew with [[Lieutenant]] [[Gandris Dyun]] as her co-pilot on the ''Fortitude''. [[File:ConundaCockpit-TROS.png|thumb|left|300px|Dreanna Conunda piloted the ''Fortitude'' through the Galactic Barrier.]] In [[35 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' the Resistance planned an [[Battle of Exegol|attack]] on the [[Sith Eternal military|forces]] of the [[Sith Eternal]] that were preparing to launch from the [[Unknown Regions]] planet [[Exegol]]. The [[droid]] [[D-O]] had provided information on the surface of the planet that revealed that the Sith Eternal's [[fleet]], the [[Final Order]], was dependent on a [[navigation tower]] to launch, so the Resistance's plan was to deploy their [[Exegol landing team]] to destroy the tower. The team, including a large number of [[orbak]] riders from [[Company 77]], a group of First Order deserters, was loaded onto the ''Fortitude'', which would serve as the sole insertion vehicle for the ground forces. Conunda and the rest of the [[Resistance navy|Resistance's forces]] then used a route provided by the [[Jedi]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] to fly through the [[Galactic Barrier]], a hard-to-navigate region of [[Hyperspace anomaly|hyperspace anomalies]] that separated Exegol from most of the known [[The galaxy|galaxy]]. ===The Battle of Exegol=== {{Quote|Head's up!''"
"''I see it! I've got a visual on the nav tower!|Dreanna Conunda alerts Finn to the navigation tower|audio=Conunda-Finn-TROSEE.flac|''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition]]''}} [[File:FortitudePilots-TROS.png|thumb|right|300px|Conunda and Gandris Dyun (both in the background) flew together at Exegol.]] During the journey, [[General]] [[Finn]], one of the new leaders of the Resistance, took Dyun's place in the [[cockpit]] and was sat with Conunda when they first arrived above Exegol and witnessed the many [[Xyston-class Star Destroyer|''Xyston''-class Star Destroyers]] of the [[Sith]] fleet, which immediately opened fire on the Resistance [[Starship|vessels]]. Resistance General [[Poe Dameron]] ordered his forces to get level with the Sith [[Star Destroyer]]s so that the enemy craft could no longer fire without hitting each other, and Conunda dodged incoming fire as she took the ''Fortitude'' down toward the navigation tower, which she pointed out to Finn. Realizing the Resistance's plan, First Order [[Allegiant General]] [[Enric Pryde]] had [[Admiral]] [[Frantis Griss]] transfer the navigation signal to the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Steadfast (Resurgent-class)|''Steadfast'']]. Seeing the navigation tower power down, Dameron initially called off the ground invasion, but sensing the signal's new origin point through [[the Force]], Finn directed Conunda to land the ''Fortitude'' on the surface of the ''Steadfast''. Finn then left the cockpit to join the landing team in the rear, and Dyun moved up to take his place beside Conunda, who shouted back to the rest of the ship that the new landing would be rough. ===An unusual landing zone=== {{Quote|They've landed a troop carrier.|Frantis Griss reports Dreanna Conunda's successful landing of the ''Fortitude''|audio=Griss-TroopCarrier-TROS.flac|}} [[File:FortitudeLanding-TROS.png|thumb|left|300px|Conunda landed the ''Fortitude'' on the surface of the ''Steadfast''.]] While the Resistance's [[starfighter]]s focused on providing them cover, the captain and her co-pilot successfully evaded fire from [[TIE/dg starfighter]]s and landed on the ''Steadfast''{{'s}} surface before opening the drop-down loading doors of the ''Fortitude''. Led by the charging orbak riders, the Resistance ground forces deployed onto the [[command ship]] and engaged the [[Sith trooper]]s that arrived to stop them. The ''Fortitude'' remained landed on the ship as Finn and his forces successfully managed to disable the ''Steadfast''{{'s}} navigation tower, after which the surviving ground forces retreated back into the ''Fortitude''. With the insertion complete, Conunda launched from the ship, although Finn and his ally [[Jannah]] remained behind in order to destroy the ''Steadfast'' completely and prevent it from restarting the signal. Ultimately, the arrival of the [[Citizens' Fleet]] in support of the Resistance and Rey's defeat of [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Sidious]] on the surface below allowed the Resistance to claim victory at Exegol and wipe out the remaining Sith forces. The ''Fortitude'' then left Exegol with the rest of the fleet and returned to Ajan Kloss, where it landed at the base so the Resistance and its allies could celebrate. ==Personality and traits== [[File:Gandris_Dyun_TROSVD.png|thumb|right|250px|Conunda flew with co-pilot Gandris Dyun, with whom she was rumored to have more than a professional relationship.]] Although her own instructors had assumed that she would be more interested in small, agile craft, Dreanna Conunda was drawn to flying large haulers due to the sense of power their [[Engine|thrusters]] generated and the inherent challenge of piloting the bulky vessels in and out of [[Spaceport|spacedocks]]. The light touch that this required was what was called for when she landed on the ''Steadfast'', which was an ideal mission for the former flight instructor.{{EncyclopediaCite|Starships of the First Order and the Resistance}} When flying with Dyun, Conunda narrowed her focus to the safest path to and from the landing zone while undertaking dangerous insertion or extraction missions. The co-pilot would then keep the transport's defenses active and maintain a wider situational awareness to warn her of encroaching threats or unforeseen hazards. This working relationship mostly consisted of unspoken communication, which Conunda and Dyun had the compatibility and chemistry to pull off, with some Resistance staffers even whispering that the pair's relationship went beyond professional. Conunda had light skin and dark [[eye]]s. ==Equipment== Dreanna Conunda wore a [[Color|yellow]] [[flight suit]] with a white vest, [[harness]], and [[life support]] system. She also wore gray [[glove]]s and a white [[flight helmet]] that bore both a blue and yellow [[Rebel Alliance starbird]] and a black and red bulls eye that was a nod to her ability to stick a landing. ==Behind the scenes== Dreanna Conunda was portrayed by [[Andreea Diac]]{{Instagram|username=iamandreeadiac|url=p/B6S6n6epTaT|name=[[Andreea Diac]]|date=December 20, 2019|quote=This is insane!😆|archiveurl=https://archive.is/hK8xq}} in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']]. In the film's credits, the character is listed only as "Lander Pilot" and the character's name, which is a [[tuckerization]] of Diac's name, was provided by the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]. ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Dreanna Conunda|soundcat=Audio files of Dreanna Conunda}} *{{Film|IX}} {{1st}} *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition (audiobook)}} *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel (audiobook)}} *[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker (Screen Comix)|''Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker'' Screen Comix]] *[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker Graphic Novel Adaptation|''Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker'' Graphic Novel Adaptation]] *[[The Rise of Skywalker Adaptation 5|''The Rise of Skywalker Adaptation'' 5]] ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' {{1stID|Dreanna Conunda}} *{{ShipsandVehiclesCite|3|Starships and Vehicles}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Starships of the First Order and the Resistance}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles (second edition)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles'', second edition]] ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Dreanna Conunda |fr=Dreanna Conunda |ja=ドレアナ・コヌンダ |ka=დრიანა კონუნდა }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Conunda, Dreanna}} [[Category:Corellian Engineering Corporation employees]] [[Category:Educators]] [[Category:Exegol landing team personnel]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]] [[Category:New Republic individuals]] [[Category:Pilots]]
